question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.

-- Let me rebuild the query correctly. The extra toppings should be added as separate rows,
-- not joined with standard toppings.

WITH deduped AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time
  FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time) as row_id,
    order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time
  FROM deduped
),
-- Get standard toppings for each pizza
standard_toppings AS (
  SELECT 
    n.row_id, n.order_id, n.customer_id, n.pizza_id, n.exclusions, n.extras, n.order_time,
    p.pizza_name,
    CAST(UNNEST(string_split(r.toppings, ', ')) AS INTEGER) as standard_topping_id
  FROM numbered n
  JOIN pizza_names p ON n.pizza_id = p.pizza_id
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON n.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
),
-- Get excluded toppings
excluded_toppings AS (
  SELECT 
    n.row_id,
    CAST(UNNEST(string_split(n.exclusions, ',')) AS INTEGER) as excluded_topping_id
  FROM numbered n
  WHERE n.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND n.exclusions != ''
),
-- Get extra toppings
extra_toppings AS (
  SELECT 
    n.row_id,
    CAST(UNNEST(string_split(n.extras, ',')) AS INTEGER) as extra_topping_id
  FROM numbered n
  WHERE n.extras IS NOT NULL AND n.extras != ''
),
-- Final ingredients: standard toppings minus exclusions, plus extras
final_ingredients AS (
  -- Standard toppings (excluding excluded ones)
  SELECT 
    s.row_id,
    s.order_id, s.customer_id, s.pizza_id, s.pizza_name, s.order_time,
    t.topping_name as ingredient
  FROM standard_toppings s
  LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings e ON s.standard_topping_id = e.excluded_topping_id
  JOIN pizza_toppings t ON s.standard_topping_id = t.topping_id
  WHERE e.excluded_topping_id IS NULL
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Extra toppings
  SELECT 
    e.row_id,
    s.order_id, s.customer_id, s.pizza_id, s.pizza_name, s.order_time,
    t.topping_name as ingredient
  FROM extra_toppings e
  JOIN standard_toppings s ON e.row_id = s.row_id
  JOIN pizza_toppings t ON e.extra_topping_id = t.topping_id
)
SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, pizza_name, order_time, ingredient
FROM final_ingredients
ORDER BY row_id, ingredient
